definition: Systems or services that generate or disseminate timely natural-hazard warnings so people, institutions or responders can take protective action. Includes warning generation, cell broadcast, other public alerts and sector-specific warnings with an explicit climate or natural-hazard connection. Monitoring without warnings is climate_information_systems; specific adaptation advice is adaptation_applications. Excludes routine notifications, emergency call-taking, dispatch, damage reporting and post-event response communications without a warning function. An existing emergency system qualifies only when the project intervention adds or improves warning capability.
